name: Content Placeholder 2
text: The increasingly widespread use of Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) devices, has brought along severe vulnerabilities against healthcare infrastructure that often traditional security controls cannot identify as specific attacks. The aim of this project is to develop an Intelligent Honeypot Framework which has the ability to precisely simulate medical devices and attract attackers. The system uses Machine Learning algorithms to process the attack data collected so far, classify the threats automatically in real-time with high precision. This proactive approach significantly enhances healthcare security by identifying zero-day attacks and minimizing risks to patient safety and data privacy.

name: Content Placeholder 2
text:
The rapid adoption of unsecured Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) devices has created a critical vulnerability in healthcare, where traditional defenses fail to detect specialized attacks on medical protocols.
Security teams are overwhelmed by the volume of threats, leaving patient safety at risk from undetected breaches.
There is an urgent need for an intelligent framework that leverages honeypots and Machine Learning to proactively trap attackers and automate real-time threat detection.
